label: Through tamping (plain line)
protection_source: IRTMM Ch.5 - machine works under traffic block; power block only if staff/equipment enter the 2 m zone (ACTM Ch.17)

label: Rail renewal
protection_source: ACTM Ch.17 - traction return continuity must be maintained; TRD attendance compelled (see rules.yaml)

label: Point machine overhaul
protection_source: GR 15.08 - no disconnection of points/signals until stop signals exhibited; written permission of the SM within station limits

label: Interlocking circuit alteration
protection_source: Zonal JPO practice: circuit alteration requiring wiring changes is done during traffic block / non-interlocking

label: OHE inspection
protection_source: ACTM Ch.17 - no work within 2 m of live OHE without permit-to-work ETR-3, which requires a power block and earthing

label: OHE height / stagger adjustment
protection_source: ACTM Ch.17 - permitted variation 20 mm in rail level, 30 mm in setting distance; adjustment required after track level alteration

label: Traction return bonding
protection_source: ACTM Ch.17 - P-Way staff may not disturb bonds; alterations require TrD staff

label: Track circuit shunting verification
protection_source: Requires train movements to verify shunting; cannot be performed inside a traffic block

label: OHE parameter measurement under load
protection_source: Requires energised OHE; cannot be performed inside a power block
